_comment: The Teferi's Puzzle Box shape: tuck the hand in any order, then draw as many as actually went under.

cards.name: Test Puzzle Box
cards.oracle_text: At the beginning of each player's draw step, that player puts the cards in their hand on the bottom of their library in any order, then draws that many cards.

abilities.text: At the beginning of each player's draw step, that player puts the cards in their hand on the bottom of their library in any order, then draws that many cards.
